name: metaharness_genome
description: ADR-150 — 7-section categorical readiness report from `metaharness genome <path>` (repo_type / agent_topology / risk_score / mcp_surface / test_confidence / publish_readiness). Upstream needs-work/blocked exit statuses are valid verdicts and return successfully as data.verdict + data.verdictExitCode; only a missing or malformed report is an error. Use when you need the categorical view (vs numeric score). Pair with metaharness_score for the full readiness picture — score-alone is wrong because two harnesses with the same harnessFit can have very different agent_topology and mcp_surface. [Return shape: {success, data, degraded, exitCode}. success===true iff exitCode===0 (includes graceful-degradation path where dep is absent — check degraded for that). success===false with exitCode===1 = intentional alert exit (read data.alert.triggered). success===false with exitCode===2 = input error (data is null).]
